lines: Good afternoon. I’m Hannah Thibedeau, and this is your Palindrome News brief.

After more than a decade with Donald Trump at the epicenter of U.S. politics, most voters appear exhausted and exasperated by him, according to The AP Voter Poll, a survey of midterm voters in all 50 states, The Associated Press reports.
House Speaker Mike Johnson will not stay on as Republican leader after GOP losses, NBC News reports.
Democrat Christina Hines flips House seat in Michigan, The Hill reports.
That’s your brief. We’ll keep watching, so you don’t have to.
